decisions.reason: The GA4 tracking plugin fits the firm's core analytics, shop-integration and plugin-development knowledge, so it can keep learning from client implementations and improve a now-standard solution commercially.
Universal Analytics is obsolete, so even with relevant tracking know-how the firm can no longer apply its knowledge to grow this product and should redirect resources to current analytics offerings.

A retail system interface plugin remains close to the firm's existing interface, customization and shop-operation capabilities, allowing it to absorb implementation feedback well despite some dependence on specific connector demand.

Shop relaunch SEO support is tightly aligned with the firm's established strengths in search marketing, analytics, usability and relaunch projects, making it easy to refine and sell as part of broader client work.

SEO workshops build directly on the firm's search-marketing expertise and client advisory experience, so they are easy to adapt from market feedback, though demand can be less stable than for implementation services.
